{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beans|Beans]] {{recipesummary|category=Bean recipes|servings=8|time=Soaking: overnight
Cooking: 2½ hours|difficulty=2 }} ==Ingredients== * 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (900 g) Navy, Great Northern, or Pea [[Cookbook:Beans|beans]], though black, kidney, or lima beans may be used for a different taste. * 1 pound (450g) [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] * 2 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] * 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] * ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]] ==Procedure== # [[Cookbook:Soak|Soak]] dry beans overnight, or use 4 cans cooked beans. # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]] (175°C). # Stir all ingredients together, then pour into casserole dish, [[Cookbook:Bean pot|bean pot]] or [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]]. # Add water from beans, or preferably stock or fresh water. Just enough to barely cover. Canned beans may need less water. Beans will absorb more water as they cook. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 2½ hours. Check after an hour for moisture level, add more water as needed to keep appropriate moistness. If beans have too much liquid, remove lid and cook a bit longer. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * A [[Cookbook:Slow Cooker|slow cooker]] may be used: cook 2½ hours on High, or 5 hours on Low.
